caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length dress rendered in pencil on aged, beige paper. The dress has a fitted bodice that tapers to a narrow waist, from which a voluminous, floor-length skirt flows outward in broad folds, indicated by lines and shading that suggest depth and texture. The neckline is wide and off-the-shoulder, adorned with multiple layers of elaborate lace or ruffled fabric that drape over the shoulders and upper arms. The background is blank, with no additional objects, and the edges of the paper show signs of discoloration and wear, particularly a darker brown staining along the margins. Handwritten notes appear in the lower left corner, and a signature is visible in the lower right corner. The overall composition centers the dress, with its skirt filling much of the lower half of the image and its bodice and neckline toward the top.
title: Dress
